title: Pip and the Puddle Path
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations i as igh, o as oa, o as u, u as oo.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations i as igh, o as oa, o as u, u as oo.

pages.text: Pip hops down the wet path.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow walking along a path dotted with small puddles after rain.

pages.text: Pip spots a shiny red bug in the water.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow noticing a small shiny red bug floating on the surface of a puddle.

pages.text: Pip has not had a bug like this.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow tilting his head, looking curiously at the unfamiliar bug.

pages.text: Pip taps the bug bit by bit.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow pecking gently and cautiously at the red bug.

pages.text: Pip gets a fright. The bug is not good!
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow jumping back with a startled expression, beak open wide.

pages.text: Pip drops the bug back in the water.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow shaking his head, the red bug dropping back into the puddle water.

pages.text: Pip hunts for a good snack.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow hopping along the path, looking around for something else to eat.

pages.text: Pip spots a fat seed on the path.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow spotting a plump seed lying on the dry part of the path.

pages.text: Pip taps the seed. It is good!
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow happily pecking at the seed, clearly enjoying it.

pages.text: Pip grins. That was a good day.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow standing contentedly on the path, puddles glinting behind him.
